name: Mondscheinspitze
kurzbeschreibung: The striking Mondscheinspitze (2,106 m) in the Karwendel rewards surefooted mountain hikers with unforgettable vistas over emerald Lake Achensee.
beschreibung:
Overview

The bold and sculpted Mondscheinspitze rises to an elevation of 2,106 meters as one of the most handsome and prominent rock summits in the eastern Karwendel. Situated directly above the Gerntal valley near Lake Achensee, this steep limestone pyramid of Hauptdolomit and Wetterstein limestone dominates the surrounding alpine skyline. Its poetic name, meaning 'Moonlight Peak', likely stems from the crescent shape of its summit ridge, which glimmers with a silvery sheen against the sky under certain light conditions. From the spacious summit plateau, marked by a timber cross, an awe-inspiring 360-degree panorama unfolds: to the east, the deep turquoise waters of Lake Achensee gleam like a sparkling fjord; to the south, glaciated giants of the Zillertal and Stubai Alps rise on the horizon; to the west, endless limestone crests of the Karwendel roll away into the distance.

Route & Requirements

Climbing the Mondscheinspitze is a classic, high-alpine mountain excursion requiring good stamina, absolute surefootedness, and a head for heights (difficulty T3 to T4). The most scenic and popular route begins at the traditional Gasthof Gernalm inn at the cul-de-sac of the Gerntal at 1,172 meters. From there, the trail winds gently through mountain forests and alpine meadows to the Schleimsattel pass (1,556 m). The final push scrambles up steep scree gullies and an exposed, cable-secured rock chimney directly to the cross (approx. 3.5 hours ascent, nearly 1,000 vertical meters). Ankle-high mountaineering boots with deep tread are mandatory. In wet or icy conditions, the route must be strictly avoided due to severe slipping and falling hazards.

Visit & Arrival

The trailhead at Gernalm is reached from Pertisau at Lake Achensee via a scenic toll road (approx. €5 per car). During summer, the local Achensee bus runs to the toll booth and up to Gernalm. By train, travel with ÖBB to Jenbach station and connect to bus line 4080 to Pertisau.

Tips

Start early in the morning on hot summer days to tackle the strenuous south-facing ascent before midday heat, and treat yourself to a hearty Tyrolean dumpling soup on the sunny terrace at Gernalm upon your return. Bring plenty of water as there are no streams along the upper ridge.
preis: Freely accessible; Gerntal toll road applies (approx. €5 per car)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible June to October in dry, snow-free conditions
